profile.title: Music Profile
profile.no_profile_hint: Create a profile to get started.
profile.profiles_hint: Select or create profiles based on your musical taste.
profile.ai_warning: Enter a Core Description or a Vibe message to update your profile with AI.
profile.vibe_description_hint: Tell the AI what you're looking for in everyday language — no structure needed. The AI will translate this into your profile.
profile.vibe_description_placeholder: e.g. "I love energetic rock with theatrical vocals like Queen. Surprise me with something new but keep it high-energy and melodic!"
profile.core_description_hint: Describe your ideal sound in your own words — genre, mood, energy, reference artists. This is the foundation of your profile.
profile.core_description_error: Core description is required when no vibe description is provided.
profile.must_have_hint: Non-negotiable traits every suggestion must have. One per line.
profile.soft_preferences_hint: Nice-to-have traits that improve a suggestion but aren't required. One per line.
profile.avoid_hint: Traits that immediately disqualify a track. One per line.
